turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Remember: I am + -ing, he/she/it is + -ing, you/we/they are + -ing. Don't forget am, is or are! Example: A woman is sitting under a tree.

Imagine a park now. Write two sentences about what people are doing.

turns.tutor:
Good start! Playing football is right. But one small word is missing. In English we need am, is or are before the -ing verb. A boy is one person, so which word do we need?

Try again, and then write one more sentence about other people in the park.
